meta.confidentiality: Contains derived NHS Pathways analysis and pathway titles. Handle according to programme information governance requirements.
meta.scope_note: Provisional ENT family definition for architecture and clinical review; not a clinically approved family boundary.

definition.principle: Start with a conservative core ENT seed, then inspect one-hop inbound and outbound pathway transfers before clinical approval.
definition.automatic_inclusion_rule: Include an active pathway when its clinical-area metadata, symptom-group metadata, or pathway title contains an explicit ENT term. Broad overlap terms such as swallowing, dizziness and facial swelling are review-only.

steps.title: Define the core ENT seed
steps.detail: Use explicit ENT metadata/title evidence only; do not use graph proximity alone.

steps.title: List every included pathway and why
steps.detail: Each inclusion carries the metadata/title evidence that triggered it.

steps.title: Trace outbound jumps
steps.detail: Find every transfer from an included ENT pathway to a pathway outside the family.

steps.title: Trace inbound jumps
steps.detail: Reverse the graph to find every non-ENT pathway that transfers into the ENT core.

steps.title: Review the boundary
steps.detail: Use inbound/outbound evidence to decide what stays external, what is shared evidence and what should be added.

steps.title: Clinical approval before BN build
steps.detail: The resulting family boundary is an evidence pack for clinical review, not an automated clinical decision.
